notes: Fraction cheat sheet in the side panel under Notes (1/16ths and 1-4 cm in decimals; View > Fraction cheat sheet turns it off). Alt+drag a measurement's number to place it anywhere with a dotted pointer back; Alt+click puts it back. Ctrl+scroll stops the number at the ends of the measurement. Deleting a note asks first. The Enter/Esc note under the number box is gone.
